extracted.name: Salad with Artichokes
extracted.description: This salad with artichoke hearts is made with mixed greens and sliced red onion, tossed with a vinaigrette dressing, and topped with grated Parmesan.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can artichoke hearts in water, drained
instruction_lines: Combine mixed greens, artichoke hearts, and onion in a large bowl.
Whisk oil, vinegar, seasoned salt, garlic powder, and pepper together in a separate bowl. Pour desired amount of dressing over the salad, and toss to coat.
Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese, and serve.
